Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Concrete Globe Pendant Light Chandelier Fixture - 6 x 6 x 30 Inches, Faux Concrete and Metal
Colors: Concrete
Materials: Concrete Resin+Metal
This faux concrete pendant light is a great style addition for an urban setting. Its design will give your space an industrial feel, yet it's simple and understated enough to blend with more traditional styles, too. Modern, minimalist style Faux concrete finish and metal A narrow profile is convenient for small spaces 6''W x 6''D x 30''H Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended)
